limitations: Eight primary cases have three independent process observations per mode; auxiliary controls have one.
Normal OS/HDF5 caches; hashing may warm stores. Fresh process does not mean cold storage.
Logical selected CSR equivalence; canonical ordering is outside clocks, native sparse ordering/widths may differ.
Repeated C++ reads reuse prepared plans/caller buffers; Python repeats native same-handle indexing/allocation. API lifecycle comparison, not equal allocation-free kernels.
C++ diagnostics are separate intercepted calls/new requests, not physical traffic, all allocators or live memory. Reuse itself was not instrumented.
Float32 CSR only; no dense/CSC, cold-cache or larger-than-memory throughput qualification.
The Python positive-stride result was incorrect; its latency is excluded.

environment.scope: existing pinned reference environment; no packages upgraded

host_check: host-before.json records a pre-run process/load snapshot; host is not exclusively reserved
